result:
Perfect! All tests pass. The bug was in line 24 of `invoicing/money.py`. The condition `while len(head) > 3:` was preventing proper grouping of digits over a lakh. 

The fix changes it to `while len(head) > 2:`, which correctly extracts 2-digit groups from right to left, leaving 1-3 digits for the leftmost group. Now 12345678 paise correctly displays as "₹1,23,456.78" instead of "₹123,456.78".

**All 10 tests pass.**
